name: sprite_builder_codespace_write
description: Write (create or overwrite) a file in the codespace workspace. Path is relative to /workspace/app (no '..', no absolute paths, cannot be the root). Max 1 MiB. Codespace must be 'ready'.

codespace_id.description: The codespace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_codespace / sprite_builder_list_codespaces).
